Your career with us

You’ve got what it takes. We’ll take you further.

Search and apply

A career at UBS

We’re the world’s largest and only truly global wealth manager, providing first-class financial advice and solutions to institutional and corporate clients worldwide, as well as private clients in Switzerland. We’re headquartered in Zurich, but you can find us in all major financial centers worldwide. 

  • Curiosity powers. AI enables.

    Your turn to shake things up.

  • Professionals

    Your expertise keeps us best-in-class.

  • A career in technology

    Tech is at the heart of our evolution. And our opportunities are as diverse as our people.

  • Students and graduates

    Preparing for launch? Learn from the best and build a career with our entry-level programs.

  • School leavers

    Pick up new skills and transition to a great career with our work-study options.
1/5

Great work is never done alone

At UBS, we put collaboration at the heart of everything we do – because together, we're more than ourselves. We encourage each other to take on new opportunities, face challenges, and share fresh ideas. When you grow, so do we. That’s what sets us apart.

Learn more about UBS

  • We own it

    If there’s potential, we’re unlocking it. Find all the support you need to grow with new skills, roles and ways of working.

  • We improve

    Life doesn’t stand still. Why should we? We look for people who are ready to match our ambition and find opportunities in new ways of thinking and doing.

  • We connect

    From the world’s leading financial experts to the talent of tomorrow, it’s our collective ideas and expertise that allow us to deliver quality work for our clients, every day.

  • We make a difference

    Our diverse skills drive success for our clients and help our communities thrive – through sustainability, volunteering, and positive action.

Employee benefits

Competitive benefits are a starting point. So, we often go above and beyond the standards. Our employees are vital, and we want them well taken care of. From physical and mental well-being to pension plans, family support and balancing life in general.

Explore benefitsof UBS employees

Who inspires us?

Our employees.

Each of us is more than one person. We’re more than ourselves. We’re our experiences, histories, skills, passions and commitments. The diverse communities we come from and the people who’ve helped shape who we are. And who we’re becoming.

At UBS, collective ideas bring results and drive our progress. It’s why we say that great work is never done alone. We do it for each other. Working hard to fulfill our potential and bring our purpose to life.

Our people and culturemake the difference

Connect with us online

Follow along for news, career advice, job opportunities, and more.
LinkedIn
Instagram
Facebook
WeChat

Learn more about UBS

  • Our locations

    Switzerland is where we call home, but you can find us on almost every continent (sorry, Antarctica).

  • Search our jobs

    Find a career that fits, either close to home or abroad. We’d love to connect with you.

  • Diversity, equity and inclusion

    The world is diverse, and our culture reflects it. Everyone at UBS can unlock their potential.

  • Our employer awards

    We’re proud to be recognized as a high-quality employer because that means we come through for our people.

     

1/4
Slide 1-4

Frequently asked questions

UBS offers a wide range of banking jobs, including investment banking jobs, wealth management jobs, trading jobs and roles in retail across global locations.

To apply for financial advisor jobs or financial analyst jobs, visit the UBS Search jobs page, search for open positions and submit your application online.

Credit analyst jobs require strong analytical and financial assessment skills, while trading jobs call for quick decision-making, market knowledge and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

Yes, UBS regularly recruits for private equity jobs and investment banking jobs, offering opportunities to work on high-profile deals and strategic financial projects.

Wealth management jobs at UBS include positions such as relationship managers, portfolio advisors and investment specialists, all focused on helping clients achieve their financial goals.

Yes, UBS provides remote banking jobs and flexible work arrangements, including remote and hybrid options, to support work-life balance and employee wellbeing.

UBS is committed to supporting employees through change, offering mentoring and internal mobility opportunities to help you grow within the organization.

The recruitment process for banking jobs at UBS typically involves an online application, assessment tests, interviews and, for some roles, case studies or technical evaluations.

Take your next step today

Join a global team of innovators, technologists, and problem-solvers who are driven by curiosity and empowered to make an impact. At Man, we tackle some of the most complex challenges in finance, investment technology and data science. Come and build the future of finance.

View open roles

At Man, excellence isn’t just a goal, it’s the way we work together. We believe in giving people the freedom to explore new perspectives and then the tools to act on them. Our team challenges convention, embraces new ideas, and collaborates to solve complex challenges in an environment that values initiative and rewards success.

From your first day, you’ll work alongside some of the most inquisitive and driven people in the industry. Success isn’t defined by a single path or outcome - it’s shaped by initiative, adaptability and continual learning.

Our commitment to you

Intellectual curiosity

We champion inquisitive thinking and bold ideas, giving you the freedom to question convention and explore innovative solutions.

Respectful collaboration

Our culture thrives on shared knowledge and diverse perspectives, where every voice is valued, and we work together to deliver the best outcomes for our clients.

Entrepreneurial spirit

We empower you to take ownership, act decisively, and turn ideas into action in an environment built for adaptability and growth.

View open roles

Your wellbeing is our priority. We are dedicated to supporting our employees and their families with innovative, competitive benefits that prioritise health, financial security, and personal growth.

From comprehensive medical coverage and mental wellness programmes to tools for professional development and community giving, we ensure every member of our team has the resources they need to thrive.

Flexible Working

Hybrid arrangements and flexible hours to support work-life balance. 

Health & Wellness

Health benefits, mental health resources, and wellness programs to help you thrive.

Family Support

Competitive parental leave and flexible working arrangements.

Professional Development

A high-performance culture that supports skill and career development.

ManKind Volunteering

Our graduate, internship, and apprenticeship programmes are designed to nurture exceptional talent and shape the future of Man. We're seeking ambitious individuals with intellectual curiosity, energy, and the determination to thrive in our fast-paced, innovative environment. While academic excellence matters, we're equally interested in your unique perspective, problem-solving ability, and drive to make a meaningful impact in global financial markets. Join us to accelerate your career alongside world-class professionals in an environment where diverse thinking drives innovation.

Graduates

Our graduate programmes welcome high-calibre graduates from various degree disciplines to embark on transformative 18–24-month rotational schemes. We offer programmes across our business, from investment management and research to technology and operations, supporting you in developing the skills and expertise needed for a successful long-term career at Man. We run a thorough induction programme, where you will gain insights to departments all across the firm, improving your understanding of how our business works. We're looking for graduates with intellectual curiosity, adaptability, and the ambition to take on increasing responsibility as you discover where your unique talents can make the greatest impact.

What we offer you
  • A buddy from our NextGen working group to help comfortably embed you into the business
  • Access to our mentorship programme, where you'll be partnered with an experienced professional to help guide your career development
  • Opportunity to undertake professional qualifications such as CFA, IMC, ACCA whilst on the Graduate Programme.
  • Dedicated support from the programme lead
Internships

Our internship programmes welcome high-potential penultimate year university students from various educational backgrounds to join intensive 12-week placements across our business. From research to technology to responsible investment, you'll gain hands-on experience while developing the foundational skills needed to successfully kickstart a career in investment management. We're looking for interns with a keen desire to learn, proactive mindset, and the curiosity to explore how your academic knowledge translates into real-world impact at one of the world's leading investment management firms.

What we offer you
  • A buddy from our NextGen working group to help comfortably embed you into the business
  • Additional activities throughout your internship to help improve your knowledge and skillset
  • Build your network with industry professionals with the potential for a return offer to our Graduate Programme
  • Dedicated support from the programme lead throughout the programme
Apprenticeships

Our Apprenticeship programme is designed to empower you from the start. You'll work alongside industry experts, tackling real‒world challenges and contributing to meaningful projects. With mentorship and a supportive learning environment, you'll have the freedom to explore your potential and the agility to adapt as you grow. If you're excited about building a career in financial services and ready to contribute to one of the world's leading investment management firms, we want to hear from you.

What we offer you

As an employee on an apprenticeship programme, you will receive:

  • Highly structured on‒the‒job training leading to a recognised qualification with one of our partner providers
  • Up to 1 day per week to allow you time for your studies
  • Dedicated support from the Programme Lead throughout your programme
  • 1-2-1 support from your coach throughout the duration of the apprenticeship
Learn more

At Man Group, we understand that careers aren’t always linear. Our Career Returners Programme is designed to support individuals returning to the workforce after an extended break of at least 24 months. Whether you’ve stepped away from work to raise a family, provide care, or pursue other life priorities, we may have the perfect opportunity for you.

We know from experience that returning to work can feel daunting, so we have partnered with Career Returners to offer a 6-month returner programme to ease the transition. The programme consists of a series of professional coaching sessions, a mentor programme and a ready-made community of former and current career returners to support with navigating the path ahead.

Inclusion at Man

Finding excellent minds means actively seeking talent from different backgrounds and a broad range of perspectives. The varied insights and approaches we each bring to problems ultimately leads to better results for our clients and a better workplace for our colleagues.

Learn more
